Design deviation recorded: bunx multi-package limitation in Bun 1.4.0 ('bunx -p pkg1 -p pkg2 cmd' fails to link non-binary packages, so commitlint cannot resolve @commitlint/config-conventional ephemerally). Solution keeps pins only in the justfile: 'tools' target provisions both packages into target/dev-tools (gitignored, stamp-guarded .pins), and commit-check refreshes a byte-identical copy of commitlint.config.ts there because commitlint resolves extends relative to the config file directory, not cwd.
